name: Volatility
source:
A game about Evilyn Kaneko, and many others, trapped within a strange motel. You as the player must gain other's trust, make core decisions that could lead to life or death, and find a way to get out of Destination Motel alive.

[From [url=https://spencerisred.itch.io/volatility]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款关于Evilyn Kaneko和其他许多人被困在一家奇怪的汽车旅馆内的游戏。作为玩家，你必须获得他人的信任，做出可能导致生或死的核心决定，并找到一种方法活着离开目的地汽车旅馆。

[来自[url=https://spencerisred.itch.io/volatility]Itch.io[/url]]
